verses.original: וְאַבְרָהָ֣ם זָקֵ֔ן בָּ֖א בַּיָּמִ֑ים וַֽיהוָ֛ה בֵּרַ֥ךְ אֶת־ אַבְרָהָ֖ם בַּכֹּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’aḇ·rā·hām zā·qên bā bay·yā·mîm Yah·weh bê·raḵ ’eṯ- ’aḇ·rā·hām bak·kōl
verses.literal: By now Abraham was old and well along in years and the LORD had blessed him in every way
verses.literalPt: E ERA Abraão já velho e adiantado em idade, e o SENHOR havia abençoado a Abraão em tudo.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אַבְרָהָ֗ם אֶל־ עַבְדּוֹ֙ זְקַ֣ן בֵּית֔וֹ הַמֹּשֵׁ֖ל בְּכָל־ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֑וֹ שִֽׂים־ נָ֥א יָדְךָ֖ תַּ֥חַת יְרֵכִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’aḇ·rā·hām ’el- ‘aḇ·dōw zə·qan bê·ṯōw ham·mō·šêl bə·ḵāl ’ă·šer- lōw śîm- nā yā·ḏə·ḵā ta·ḥaṯ yə·rê·ḵî
verses.literal: So Abraham instructed . . . the chief servant of his household who managed all he owned Place . . . your hand under my thigh
verses.literalPt: E disse Abraão ao seu servo, o mais velho da casa, que tinha o governo sobre tudo o que possuía: Põe agora a tua mão debaixo da minha coxa,

verses.original: וְאַשְׁבִּ֣יעֲךָ֔ בַּֽיהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וֵֽאלֹהֵ֖י הָאָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־ תִקַּ֤ח אִשָּׁה֙ לִבְנִ֔י מִבְּנוֹת֙ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י יוֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּקִרְבּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’aš·bî·‘ă·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê haš·šā·ma·yim wê·lō·hê hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer lō- ṯiq·qaḥ ’iš·šāh liḇ·nî mib·bə·nō·wṯ hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî yō·wō·šêḇ bə·qir·bōw
verses.literal: and I will have you swear by the LORD the God of heaven and the God of earth that you will not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites among whom I am dwelling
verses.literalPt: Para que eu te faça jurar pelo SENHOR Deus dos céus e Deus da terra, que não tomarás para meu filho mulher das filhas dos cananeus, no meio dos quais eu habito.

verses.original: כִּ֧י אֶל־ אַרְצִ֛י וְאֶל־ מוֹלַדְתִּ֖י תֵּלֵ֑ךְ וְלָקַחְתָּ֥ אִשָּׁ֖ה לִבְנִ֥י לְיִצְחָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’el- ’ar·ṣî wə·’el- mō·w·laḏ·tî tê·lêḵ wə·lā·qaḥ·tā ’iš·šāh liḇ·nî lə·yiṣ·ḥāq
verses.literal: but will go to my country and my kindred to take a wife for my son Isaac
verses.literalPt: Mas que irás à minha terra e à minha parentela, e dali tomarás mulher para meu filho Isaque.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ הָעֶ֔בֶד אוּלַי֙ לֹא־ תֹאבֶ֣ה הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה לָלֶ֥כֶת אַחֲרַ֖י אֶל־ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֑את הֶֽהָשֵׁ֤ב אָשִׁיב֙ אֶת־ בִּנְךָ֔ אֶל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ יָצָ֥אתָ מִשָּֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw hā·‘e·ḇeḏ ’ū·lay lō- ṯō·ḇeh hā·’iš·šāh lā·le·ḵeṯ ’a·ḥă·ray ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ he·hā·šêḇ ’ā·šîḇ ’eṯ- bin·ḵā ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- yā·ṣā·ṯā miš·šām
verses.literal: The servant asked him What if the woman is unwilling . . . to follow me . . . to this land Shall I then take your son back . . . . . . to the land from which you came
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhe o servo: Se porventura não quiser seguir-me a mulher a esta terra, farei, pois, tornar o teu filho à terra donde saíste?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלָ֖יו אַבְרָהָ֑ם הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֔ פֶּן־ תָּשִׁ֥יב אֶת־ בְּנִ֖י שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw ’aḇ·rā·hām hiš·šā·mer lə·ḵā pen- tā·šîḇ ’eṯ- bə·nî šām·māh
verses.literal: Abraham replied . . . Make sure that you do not take my son back there
verses.literalPt: E Abraão lhe disse: Guarda-te, que não faças lá tornar o meu filho.

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה׀ אֱלֹהֵ֣י הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם אֲשֶׁ֨ר לְקָחַ֜נִי מִבֵּ֣ית אָבִי֮ וּמֵאֶ֣רֶץ מֽוֹלַדְתִּי֒ וַאֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּר־ לִ֜י וַאֲשֶׁ֤ר נִֽשְׁבַּֽע־ לִי֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לְזַ֨רְעֲךָ֔ אֶתֵּ֖ן אֶת־ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֑את ה֗וּא יִשְׁלַ֤ח מַלְאָכוֹ֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ וְלָקַחְתָּ֥ אִשָּׁ֛ה לִבְנִ֖י מִשָּֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê haš·šā·ma·yim ’ă·šer lə·qā·ḥa·nî mib·bêṯ ’ā·ḇî ū·mê·’e·reṣ mō·w·laḏ·tî wa·’ă·šer dib·ber- lî wa·’ă·šer niš·ba‘- lî lê·mōr lə·zar·‘ă·ḵā ’et·tên ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ hū yiš·laḥ mal·’ā·ḵōw lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā wə·lā·qaḥ·tā ’iš·šāh liḇ·nî miš·šām
verses.literal: The LORD the God of heaven who brought me from my father’s house and my native land who spoke to me and promised me on oath . . . saying To your offspring I will give this land He will send His angel before you so that you can take a wife for my son from there
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR Deus dos céus, que me tomou da casa de meu pai e da terra da minha parentela, e que me falou, e que me jurou, dizendo: À tua descendência darei esta terra; ele enviará o seu anjo adiante da tua face, para que tomes mulher de lá para meu filho.

verses.original: וְאִם־ לֹ֨א תֹאבֶ֤ה הָֽאִשָּׁה֙ לָלֶ֣כֶת אַחֲרֶ֔יךָ וְנִקִּ֕יתָ מִשְּׁבֻעָתִ֖י זֹ֑את רַ֣ק אֶת־ בְּנִ֔י לֹ֥א תָשֵׁ֖ב שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- lō ṯō·ḇeh hā·’iš·šāh lā·le·ḵeṯ ’a·ḥă·re·ḵā wə·niq·qî·ṯā miš·šə·ḇu·‘ā·ṯî zōṯ raq ’eṯ- bə·nî lō ṯā·šêḇ šām·māh
verses.literal: And if the woman is unwilling . . . to follow you then you are released from this oath of mine Only do not take my son back there
verses.literalPt: Se a mulher, porém, não quiser seguir-te, serás livre deste meu juramento; somente não faças lá tornar a meu filho.

verses.original: וַיָּ֤שֶׂם הָעֶ֙בֶד֙ אֶת־ יָד֔וֹ תַּ֛חַת יֶ֥רֶךְ אַבְרָהָ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֑יו וַיִּשָּׁ֣בַֽע ל֔וֹ עַל־ הַדָּבָ֖ר הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śem hā·‘e·ḇeḏ ’eṯ- yā·ḏōw ta·ḥaṯ ye·reḵ ’aḇ·rā·hām ’ă·ḏō·nāw way·yiš·šā·ḇa‘ lōw ‘al- had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh
verses.literal: So the servant placed his hand under the thigh of his master Abraham and swore an oath to him concerning this matter
verses.literalPt: Então pôs o servo a sua mão debaixo da coxa de Abraão seu senhor, e jurou-lhe sobre este negócio.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח הָ֠עֶבֶד עֲשָׂרָ֨ה גְמַלִּ֜ים מִגְּמַלֵּ֤י אֲדֹנָיו֙ וַיֵּ֔לֶךְ וְכָל־ ט֥וּב אֲדֹנָ֖יו בְּיָד֑וֹ וַיָּ֗קָם וַיֵּ֛לֶךְ אֶל־ אֲרַ֥ם נַֽהֲרַ֖יִם אֶל־ עִ֥יר נָחֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ hā·‘e·ḇeḏ ‘ă·śā·rāh ḡə·mal·lîm mig·gə·mal·lê ’ă·ḏō·nāw way·yê·leḵ wə·ḵāl ṭūḇ ’ă·ḏō·nāw bə·yā·ḏōw way·yā·qām way·yê·leḵ ’el- ’ă·ram na·hă·ra·yim ’el- ‘îr nā·ḥō·wr
verses.literal: Then the servant took ten of his master’s camels . . . and departed with all manner of good things from his master in hand And he set out . . . for Nahor’s hometown in Aram-naharaim
verses.literalPt: E o servo tomou dez camelos, dos camelos do seu senhor, e partiu, pois que todos os bens de seu senhor estavam em sua mão, e levantou-se e partiu para Mesopotâmia, para a cidade de Naor.

verses.original: וַיַּבְרֵ֧ךְ הַגְּמַלִּ֛ים מִח֥וּץ לָעִ֖יר אֶל־ בְּאֵ֣ר הַמָּ֑יִם לְעֵ֣ת עֶ֔רֶב לְעֵ֖ת צֵ֥את הַשֹּׁאֲבֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaḇ·rêḵ hag·gə·mal·lîm mi·ḥūṣ lā·‘îr ’el- bə·’êr ham·mā·yim lə·‘êṯ ‘e·reḇ lə·‘êṯ ṣêṯ haš·šō·’ă·ḇōṯ
verses.literal: As evening approached . . . he made the camels kneel down near the well . . . outside the town at the time when the women went out to draw water
verses.literalPt: E fez ajoelhar os camelos fora da cidade, junto a um poço de água, pela tarde, ao tempo que as moças saíam a tirar água.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמַ֓ר׀ יְהוָ֗ה אֱלֹהֵי֙ אֲדֹנִ֣י אַבְרָהָ֔ם הַקְרֵה־ נָ֥א לְפָנַ֖י הַיּ֑וֹם וַעֲשֵׂה־ חֶ֕סֶד עִ֖ם אֲדֹנִ֥י אַבְרָהָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḏō·nî ’aḇ·rā·hām haq·rêh- nā lə·p̄ā·nay hay·yō·wm wa·‘ă·śêh- ḥe·seḏ ‘im ’ă·ḏō·nî ’aḇ·rā·hām
verses.literal: O LORD God of my master Abraham he prayed please grant me success today . . . . . . and show kindness to my master Abraham
verses.literalPt: E disse: Ó SENHOR, Deus de meu senhor Abraão, dá-me hoje bom encontro, e faze beneficência ao meu senhor Abraão!

verses.original: הִנֵּ֛ה אָנֹכִ֥י נִצָּ֖ב עַל־ עֵ֣ין הַמָּ֑יִם וּבְנוֹת֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י הָעִ֔יר יֹצְאֹ֖ת לִשְׁאֹ֥ב מָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî niṣ·ṣāḇ ‘al- ‘ên ham·mā·yim ū·ḇə·nō·wṯ ’an·šê hā·‘îr yō·ṣə·’ōṯ liš·’ōḇ mā·yim
verses.literal: Here I am standing beside the spring . . . and the daughters of the townspeople . . . are coming out to draw water
verses.literalPt: Eis que eu estou em pé junto à fonte de água e as filhas dos homens desta cidade saem para tirar água;

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה הַֽנַּעֲרָ֗ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֹמַ֤ר אֵלֶ֙יהָ֙ הַטִּי־ נָ֤א כַדֵּךְ֙ וְאֶשְׁתֶּ֔ה וְאָמְרָ֣ה שְׁתֵ֔ה וְגַם־ גְּמַלֶּ֖יךָ אַשְׁקֶ֑ה אֹתָ֤הּ הֹכַ֙חְתָּ֙ לְעַבְדְּךָ֣ לְיִצְחָ֔ק וּבָ֣הּ אֵדַ֔ע כִּי־ עָשִׂ֥יתָ חֶ֖סֶד עִם־ אֲדֹנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh han·na·‘ă·rā ’ă·šer ’ō·mar ’ê·le·hā haṭ·ṭî- nā ḵad·dêḵ wə·’eš·teh wə·’ā·mə·rāh šə·ṯêh wə·ḡam- gə·mal·le·ḵā ’aš·qeh ’ō·ṯāh hō·ḵaḥ·tā lə·‘aḇ·də·ḵā lə·yiṣ·ḥāq ū·ḇāh ’ê·ḏa‘ kî- ‘ā·śî·ṯā ḥe·seḏ ‘im- ’ă·ḏō·nî
verses.literal: Now may it happen that the girl to whom I say Please let down your jar that I may drink and who responds Drink and I will water your camels as well let her be the one You have appointed for Your servant Isaac By this I will know that You have shown kindness to my master
verses.literalPt: Seja, pois, que a donzela, a quem eu disser: Abaixa agora o teu cântaro para que eu beba; e ela disser: Bebe, e também darei de beber aos teus camelos; esta seja a quem designaste ao teu servo Isaque, e que eu conheça nisso que usaste de benevolência com meu senhor.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי־ ה֗וּא טֶרֶם֮ כִּלָּ֣ה לְדַבֵּר֒ וְהִנֵּ֧ה רִבְקָ֣ה יֹצֵ֗את אֲשֶׁ֤ר יֻלְּדָה֙ לִבְתוּאֵ֣ל בֶּן־ מִלְכָּ֔ה אֵ֥שֶׁת נָח֖וֹר אֲחִ֣י אַבְרָהָ֑ם וְכַדָּ֖הּ עַל־ שִׁכְמָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî- hū ṭe·rem kil·lāh lə·ḏab·bêr wə·hin·nêh riḇ·qāh yō·ṣêṯ ’ă·šer yul·lə·ḏāh liḇ·ṯū·’êl ben- mil·kāh ’ê·šeṯ nā·ḥō·wr ’ă·ḥî ’aḇ·rā·hām wə·ḵad·dāh ‘al- šiḵ·māh
verses.literal: Before the servant had finished praying Rebekah came out with her jar on her shoulder She was the daughter of Bethuel son of Milcah the wife of Abraham’s brother Nahor
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, antes que ele acabasse de falar, eis que Rebeca, que havia nascido a Betuel, filho de Milca, mulher de Naor, irmão de Abraão, saía com o seu cântaro sobre o seu ombro.

verses.original: וְהַֽנַּעֲרָ֗ טֹבַ֤ת מַרְאֶה֙ מְאֹ֔ד בְּתוּלָ֕ה וְאִ֖ישׁ לֹ֣א יְדָעָ֑הּ וַתֵּ֣רֶד הָעַ֔יְנָה וַתְּמַלֵּ֥א כַדָּ֖הּ וַתָּֽעַל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·han·na·‘ă·rā ṭō·ḇaṯ mar·’eh mə·’ōḏ bə·ṯū·lāh wə·’îš lō yə·ḏā·‘āh wat·tê·reḏ hā·‘ay·nāh wat·tə·mal·lê ḵad·dāh wat·tā·‘al
verses.literal: Now the girl was very beautiful . . . a virgin . . . who had not had relations with any man She went down to the spring filled her jar and came up again
verses.literalPt: E a donzela era mui formosa à vista, virgem, a quem homem não havia conhecido; e desceu à fonte, e encheu o seu cântaro e subiu.

verses.original: וַיָּ֥רָץ הָעֶ֖בֶד לִקְרָאתָ֑הּ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר הַגְמִיאִ֥ינִי נָ֛א מְעַט־ מַ֖יִם מִכַּדֵּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·rāṣ hā·‘e·ḇeḏ liq·rā·ṯāh way·yō·mer haḡ·mî·’î·nî nā mə·‘aṭ- ma·yim mik·kad·dêḵ
verses.literal: So the servant ran to meet her and said Please let me have a little water from your jar
verses.literalPt: Então o servo correu-lhe ao encontro, e disse: Peço-te, deixa-me beber um pouco de água do teu cântaro.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֖אמֶר שְׁתֵ֣ה אֲדֹנִ֑י וַתְּמַהֵ֗ר וַתֹּ֧רֶד כַּדָּ֛הּ עַל־ יָדָ֖הּ וַתַּשְׁקֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer šə·ṯêh ’ă·ḏō·nî wat·tə·ma·hêr wat·tō·reḏ kad·dāh ‘al- yā·ḏāh wat·taš·qê·hū
verses.literal: Drink my lord she replied and she quickly lowered her jar to her hands and gave him a drink
verses.literalPt: E ela disse: Bebe, meu SENHOR. E apressou-se e abaixou o seu cântaro sobre a sua mão e deu-lhe de beber.

verses.original: וַתְּכַ֖ל לְהַשְׁקֹת֑וֹ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר גַּ֤ם לִגְמַלֶּ֙יךָ֙ אֶשְׁאָ֔ב עַ֥ד אִם־ כִּלּ֖וּ לִשְׁתֹּֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·ḵal lə·haš·qō·ṯōw wat·tō·mer gam liḡ·mal·le·ḵā ’eš·’āḇ ‘aḏ ’im- kil·lū liš·tōṯ
verses.literal: After she had given him a drink she said I will also draw water for your camels until . . . they have had enough to drink
verses.literalPt: E, acabando ela de lhe dar de beber, disse: Tirarei também água para os teus camelos, até que acabem de beber.

verses.original: וַתְּמַהֵ֗ר וַתְּעַ֤ר כַּדָּהּ֙ אֶל־ הַשֹּׁ֔קֶת וַתָּ֥רָץ ע֛וֹד אֶֽל־ הַבְּאֵ֖ר לִשְׁאֹ֑ב וַתִּשְׁאַ֖ב לְכָל־ גְּמַלָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·ma·hêr wat·tə·‘ar kad·dāh ’el- haš·šō·qeṯ wat·tā·rāṣ ‘ō·wḏ ’el- hab·bə·’êr liš·’ōḇ wat·tiš·’aḇ lə·ḵāl gə·mal·lāw
verses.literal: And she quickly emptied her jar into the trough and ran back to the well to draw water until she had drawn water for all his camels
verses.literalPt: E apressou-se, e despejou o seu cântaro no bebedouro, e correu outra vez ao poço para tirar água, e tirou para todos os seus camelos.

verses.original: וְהָאִ֥ישׁ מִשְׁתָּאֵ֖ה לָ֑הּ מַחֲרִ֕ישׁ לָדַ֗עַת הַֽהִצְלִ֧יחַ יְהוָ֛ה דַּרְכּ֖וֹ אִם־ לֹֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’îš miš·tā·’êh lāh ma·ḥă·rîš lā·ḏa·‘aṯ ha·hiṣ·lî·aḥ Yah·weh dar·kōw ’im- lō
verses.literal: Meanwhile, the man watched her silently to see whether or not the LORD had made his journey a success
verses.literalPt: E o homem estava admirado de vê-la, calando-se, para saber se o SENHOR havia prosperado a sua jornada ou não.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר כִּלּ֤וּ הַגְּמַלִּים֙ לִשְׁתּ֔וֹת וַיִּקַּ֤ח הָאִישׁ֙ נֶ֣זֶם זָהָ֔ב בֶּ֖קַע מִשְׁקָל֑וֹ וּשְׁנֵ֤י צְמִידִים֙ עַל־ יָדֶ֔יהָ עֲשָׂרָ֥ה זָהָ֖ב מִשְׁקָלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ka·’ă·šer kil·lū hag·gə·mal·lîm liš·tō·wṯ way·yiq·qaḥ hā·’îš ne·zem zā·hāḇ be·qa‘ miš·qā·lōw ū·šə·nê ṣə·mî·ḏîm ‘al- yā·ḏe·hā ‘ă·śā·rāh zā·hāḇ miš·qā·lām
verses.literal: And after the camels had finished drinking he took out a gold ring weighing a beka and two gold bracelets for her wrists weighing ten shekels
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que, acabando os camelos de beber, tomou o homem um pendente de ouro de meio siclo de peso, e duas pulseiras para as suas mãos, do peso de dez siclos de ouro;

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ בַּת־ מִ֣י אַ֔תְּ הַגִּ֥ידִי נָ֖א לִ֑י הֲיֵ֧שׁ בֵּית־ אָבִ֛יךְ מָק֥וֹם לָ֖נוּ לָלִֽין׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer baṯ- mî ’at hag·gî·ḏî nā lî hă·yêš bêṯ- ’ā·ḇîḵ mā·qō·wm lā·nū lā·lîn
verses.literal: Whose daughter are you he asked Please tell me is there room in your father’s house for us to spend the night
verses.literalPt: E disse: De quem és filha? Faze-mo saber, peço-te. Há também em casa de teu pai lugar para nós pousarmos?

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔יו בַּת־ בְּתוּאֵ֖ל אָנֹ֑כִי בֶּן־ מִלְכָּ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָלְדָ֖ה לְנָחֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer ’ê·lāw baṯ- bə·ṯū·’êl ’ā·nō·ḵî ben- mil·kāh ’ă·šer yā·lə·ḏāh lə·nā·ḥō·wr
verses.literal: She replied . . . I am the daughter of Bethuel the son that Milcah bore to Nahor
verses.literalPt: E ela lhe disse: Eu sou a filha de Betuel, filho de Milca, o qual ela deu a Naor.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔יו גַּם־ תֶּ֥בֶן גַּם־ מִסְפּ֖וֹא רַ֣ב עִמָּ֑נוּ גַּם־ מָק֖וֹם לָלֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer ’ê·lāw gam- te·ḇen gam- mis·pō·w raḇ ‘im·mā·nū gam- mā·qō·wm lā·lūn
verses.literal: Then she added . . . We have . . . plenty of straw and feed as well as a place for you to spend the night
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe mais: Também temos palha e muito pasto, e lugar para passar a noite.

verses.original: וַיִּקֹּ֣ד הָאִ֔ישׁ וַיִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qōḏ hā·’îš way·yiš·ta·ḥū Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then the man bowed down and worshiped the LORD
verses.literalPt: Então inclinou-se aquele homem e adorou ao SENHOR,

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר בָּר֤וּךְ יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵי֙ אֲדֹנִ֣י אַבְרָהָ֔ם אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹֽא־ עָזַ֥ב חַסְדּ֛וֹ וַאֲמִתּ֖וֹ מֵעִ֣ם אֲדֹנִ֑י אָנֹכִ֗י בַּדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ נָחַ֣נִי יְהוָ֔ה בֵּ֖ית אֲחֵ֥י אֲדֹנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer bā·rūḵ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḏō·nî ’aḇ·rā·hām ’ă·šer lō- ‘ā·zaḇ ḥas·dōw wa·’ă·mit·tōw mê·‘im ’ă·ḏō·nî ’ā·nō·ḵî bad·de·reḵ nā·ḥa·nî Yah·weh bêṯ ’ă·ḥê ’ă·ḏō·nî
verses.literal: saying Blessed be the LORD the God of my master Abraham who has not withheld His kindness and faithfulness from my master As for me the LORD has led me on the journey to the house of my master’s relatives
verses.literalPt: E disse: Bendito seja o SENHOR Deus de meu senhor Abraão, que não retirou a sua benevolência e a sua verdade de meu senhor; quanto a mim, o SENHOR me guiou no caminho à casa dos irmãos de meu senhor.

verses.original: וַתָּ֙רָץ֙ הַֽנַּעֲרָ֔ וַתַּגֵּ֖ד לְבֵ֣ית אִמָּ֑הּ כַּדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·rāṣ han·na·‘ă·rā wat·tag·gêḏ lə·ḇêṯ ’im·māh kad·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh
verses.literal: The girl ran and told her mother’s household about these things
verses.literalPt: E a donzela correu, e fez saber estas coisas na casa de sua mãe.

verses.original: וּלְרִבְקָ֥ה אָ֖ח וּשְׁמ֣וֹ לָבָ֑ן וַיָּ֨רָץ לָבָ֧ן אֶל־ הָאִ֛ישׁ הַח֖וּצָה אֶל־ הָעָֽיִן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·riḇ·qāh ’āḥ ū·šə·mōw lā·ḇān way·yā·rāṣ lā·ḇān ’el- hā·’îš ha·ḥū·ṣāh ’el- hā·‘ā·yin
verses.literal: Now Rebekah had a brother named Laban and he rushed out to the man at the spring
verses.literalPt: E Rebeca tinha um irmão cujo nome era Labão, o qual correu ao encontro daquele homem até a fonte.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ כִּרְאֹ֣ת אֶת־ הַנֶּ֗זֶם וְֽאֶת־ הַצְּמִדִים֮ עַל־ יְדֵ֣י אֲחֹתוֹ֒ וּכְשָׁמְע֗וֹ אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֞י רִבְקָ֤ה אֲחֹתוֹ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר כֹּֽה־ דִבֶּ֥ר אֵלַ֖י הָאִ֑ישׁ וַיָּבֹא֙ אֶל־ הָאִ֔ישׁ וְהִנֵּ֛ה עֹמֵ֥ד עַל־ הַגְּמַלִּ֖ים עַל־ הָעָֽיִן׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kir·’ōṯ ’eṯ- han·ne·zem wə·’eṯ- haṣ·ṣə·mi·ḏîm ‘al- yə·ḏê ’ă·ḥō·ṯōw ū·ḵə·šā·mə·‘ōw ’eṯ- diḇ·rê riḇ·qāh ’ă·ḥō·ṯōw lê·mōr kōh- ḏib·ber ’ê·lay hā·’îš way·yā·ḇō ’el- hā·’îš wə·hin·nêh ‘ō·mêḏ ‘al- hag·gə·mal·lîm ‘al- hā·‘ā·yin
verses.literal: As soon as he saw the ring and the bracelets on his sister’s wrists and heard - . . . Rebekah’s words The man said this to me he went and found the man standing by the camels near the spring
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que, quando ele viu o pendente, e as pulseiras sobre as mãos de sua irmã, e quando ouviu as palavras de sua irmã Rebeca, que dizia: Assim me falou aquele homem; foi ter com o homem, que estava em pé junto aos camelos, à fonte,

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר בּ֖וֹא בְּר֣וּךְ יְהוָ֑ה לָ֤מָּה תַעֲמֹד֙ בַּח֔וּץ וְאָנֹכִי֙ פִּנִּ֣יתִי הַבַּ֔יִת וּמָק֖וֹם לַגְּמַלִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer bō·w bə·rūḵ Yah·weh lām·māh ṯa·‘ă·mōḏ ba·ḥūṣ wə·’ā·nō·ḵî pin·nî·ṯî hab·ba·yiṯ ū·mā·qō·wm lag·gə·mal·lîm
verses.literal: Come you who are blessed by the LORD said Laban Why are you standing out here I have prepared the house and a place for the camels
verses.literalPt: E disse: Entra, bendito do SENHOR; por que estás fora? pois eu já preparei a casa, e o lugar para os camelos.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֤א הָאִישׁ֙ הַבַּ֔יְתָה וַיְפַתַּ֖ח הַגְּמַלִּ֑ים וַיִּתֵּ֨ן תֶּ֤בֶן וּמִסְפּוֹא֙ לַגְּמַלִּ֔ים וּמַ֙יִם֙ לִרְחֹ֣ץ רַגְלָ֔יו וְרַגְלֵ֥י הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō hā·’îš hab·bay·ṯāh way·p̄at·taḥ hag·gə·mal·lîm way·yit·tên te·ḇen ū·mis·pō·w lag·gə·mal·lîm ū·ma·yim lir·ḥōṣ raḡ·lāw wə·raḡ·lê hā·’ă·nā·šîm ’ă·šer ’it·tōw
verses.literal: So the man came to the house and the camels were unloaded Straw and feed were brought to the camels and water to wash his feet and the feet of his companions
verses.literalPt: Então veio aquele homem à casa, e desataram os camelos, e deram palha e pasto aos camelos, e água para lavar os pés dele, e os pés dos homens que estavam com ele.

verses.original: וַיִּישֶׂם לְפָנָיו֙ לֶאֱכֹ֔ל וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לֹ֣א אֹכַ֔ל עַ֥ד אִם־ דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי דְּבָרָ֑י וַיֹּ֖אמֶר דַּבֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yī·śɛm lə·p̄ā·nāw le·’ĕ·ḵōl way·yō·mer lō ’ō·ḵal ‘aḏ ’im- dib·bar·tî də·ḇā·rāy way·yō·mer dab·bêr
verses.literal: Then a meal was set before the man but he said I will not . . . eat until . . . I have told you what I came to say So Laban said Please speak
verses.literalPt: Depois puseram comida diante dele. Ele, porém, disse: Não comerei, até que tenha dito as minhas palavras. E ele disse: Fala.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמַ֑ר עֶ֥בֶד אַבְרָהָ֖ם אָנֹֽכִי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mar ‘e·ḇeḏ ’aḇ·rā·hām ’ā·nō·ḵî
verses.literal: I am Abraham’s servant he replied
verses.literalPt: Então disse: Eu sou o servo de Abraão.

verses.original: וַיהוָ֞ה בֵּרַ֧ךְ אֶת־ אֲדֹנִ֛י מְאֹ֖ד וַיִּגְדָּ֑ל וַיִּתֶּן־ ל֞וֹ צֹ֤אן וּבָקָר֙ וְכֶ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֔ב וַעֲבָדִם֙ וּשְׁפָחֹ֔ת וּגְמַלִּ֖ים וַחֲמֹרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh bê·raḵ ’eṯ- ’ă·ḏō·nî mə·’ōḏ way·yiḡ·dāl way·yit·ten- lōw ṣōn ū·ḇā·qār wə·ḵe·sep̄ wə·zā·hāḇ wa·‘ă·ḇā·ḏim ū·šə·p̄ā·ḥōṯ ū·ḡə·mal·lîm wa·ḥă·mō·rîm
verses.literal: The LORD has greatly blessed my master and he has become rich He has given him sheep and cattle silver and gold menservants and maidservants camels and donkeys
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR abençoou muito o meu senhor, de maneira que foi engrandecido, e deu-lhe ovelhas e vacas, e prata e ouro, e servos e servas, e camelos e jumentos.

verses.original: וַתֵּ֡לֶד שָׂרָה֩ אֵ֨שֶׁת אֲדֹנִ֥י בֵן֙ לַֽאדֹנִ֔י אַחֲרֵ֖י זִקְנָתָ֑הּ וַיִּתֶּן־ לּ֖וֹ אֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·leḏ śā·rāh ’ê·šeṯ ’ă·ḏō·nî ḇên la·ḏō·nî ’a·ḥă·rê ziq·nā·ṯāh way·yit·ten- lō ’eṯ- kāl- ’ă·šer- lōw
verses.literal: My master’s wife Sarah has borne him a son in her old age and my master has given him everything he owns
verses.literalPt: E Sara, a mulher do meu senhor, deu à luz um filho a meu senhor depois da sua velhice, e ele deu-lhe tudo quanto tem.

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁבִּעֵ֥נִי אֲדֹנִ֖י לֵאמֹ֑ר לֹא־ תִקַּ֤ח אִשָּׁה֙ לִבְנִ֔י מִבְּנוֹת֙ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י יֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּאַרְצֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaš·bi·‘ê·nî ’ă·ḏō·nî lê·mōr lō- ṯiq·qaḥ ’iš·šāh liḇ·nî mib·bə·nō·wṯ hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî yō·šêḇ bə·’ar·ṣōw
verses.literal: My master made me swear an oath and said You shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites in whose land I dwell
verses.literalPt: E meu senhor me fez jurar, dizendo: Não tomarás mulher para meu filho das filhas dos cananeus, em cuja terra habito;

verses.original: אִם־ לֹ֧א אֶל־ בֵּית־ אָבִ֛י תֵּלֵ֖ךְ וְאֶל־ מִשְׁפַּחְתִּ֑י וְלָקַחְתָּ֥ אִשָּׁ֖ה לִבְנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- lō ’el- bêṯ- ’ā·ḇî tê·lêḵ wə·’el- miš·paḥ·tî wə·lā·qaḥ·tā ’iš·šāh liḇ·nî
verses.literal: but . . . you shall go to my father’s house and to my kindred to take a wife for my son
verses.literalPt: Irás, porém, à casa de meu pai, e à minha família, e tomarás mulher para meu filho.

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֖ר אֶל־ אֲדֹנִ֑י אֻלַ֛י לֹא־ תֵלֵ֥ךְ הָאִשָּׁ֖ה אַחֲרָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar ’el- ’ă·ḏō·nî ’u·lay lō- ṯê·lêḵ hā·’iš·šāh ’a·ḥă·rāy
verses.literal: Then I asked . . . my master What if the woman will not come back with me
verses.literalPt: Então disse eu ao meu senhor: Porventura não me seguirá a mulher.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑י יְהוָ֞ה אֲשֶׁר־ הִתְהַלַּ֣כְתִּי לְפָנָ֗יו יִשְׁלַ֨ח מַלְאָכ֤וֹ אִתָּךְ֙ וְהִצְלִ֣יחַ דַּרְכֶּ֔ךָ וְלָקַחְתָּ֤ אִשָּׁה֙ לִבְנִ֔י מִמִּשְׁפַּחְתִּ֖י וּמִבֵּ֥ית אָבִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāy Yah·weh ’ă·šer- hiṯ·hal·laḵ·tî lə·p̄ā·nāw yiš·laḥ mal·’ā·ḵōw ’it·tāḵ wə·hiṣ·lî·aḥ dar·ke·ḵā wə·lā·qaḥ·tā ’iš·šāh liḇ·nî mim·miš·paḥ·tî ū·mib·bêṯ ’ā·ḇî
verses.literal: And he told me The LORD before whom I have walked will send His angel with you and make your journey a success so that you may take a wife for my son from my kindred and from my father’s house
verses.literalPt: E ele me disse: O SENHOR, em cuja presença tenho andado, enviará o seu anjo contigo, e prosperará o teu caminho, para que tomes mulher para meu filho da minha família e da casa de meu pai;

verses.original: אָ֤ז תִּנָּקֶה֙ מֵאָ֣לָתִ֔י כִּ֥י תָב֖וֹא אֶל־ מִשְׁפַּחְתִּ֑י וְאִם־ לֹ֤א יִתְּנוּ֙ לָ֔ךְ וְהָיִ֥יתָ נָקִ֖י מֵאָלָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz tin·nā·qeh mê·’ā·lā·ṯî kî ṯā·ḇō·w ’el- miš·paḥ·tî wə·’im- lō yit·tə·nū lāḵ wə·hā·yî·ṯā nā·qî mê·’ā·lā·ṯî
verses.literal: And when you go to my kindred - if they refuse to give her to you then you will be released from my oath
verses.literalPt: Então serás livre do meu juramento, quando fores à minha família; e se não te derem, livre serás do meu juramento.

verses.original: וָאָבֹ֥א הַיּ֖וֹם אֶל־ הָעָ֑יִן וָאֹמַ֗ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵי֙ אֲדֹנִ֣י אַבְרָהָ֔ם אִם־ יֶשְׁךָ־ נָּא֙ מַצְלִ֣יחַ דַּרְכִּ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י הֹלֵ֥ךְ עָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ā·ḇō hay·yō·wm ’el- hā·‘ā·yin wā·’ō·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḏō·nî ’aḇ·rā·hām ’im- yeš·ḵā- nā maṣ·lî·aḥ dar·kî ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî hō·lêḵ ‘ā·le·hā
verses.literal: So when I came to the spring today I prayed O LORD God of my master Abraham if only You would . . . make my journey - . . . . . . a success
verses.literalPt: E hoje cheguei à fonte, e disse: Ó SENHOR, Deus de meu senhor Abraão, se tu agora prosperas o meu caminho, no qual eu ando,

verses.original: הִנֵּ֛ה אָנֹכִ֥י נִצָּ֖ב עַל־ עֵ֣ין הַמָּ֑יִם וְהָיָ֤ה הָֽעַלְמָה֙ הַיֹּצֵ֣את לִשְׁאֹ֔ב וְאָמַרְתִּ֣י אֵלֶ֔יהָ הַשְׁקִֽינִי־ נָ֥א מְעַט־ מַ֖יִם מִכַּדֵּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî niṣ·ṣāḇ ‘al- ‘ên ham·mā·yim wə·hā·yāh hā·‘al·māh hay·yō·ṣêṯ liš·’ōḇ wə·’ā·mar·tî ’ê·le·hā haš·qî·nî- nā mə·‘aṭ- ma·yim mik·kad·dêḵ
verses.literal: Here I am standing beside this spring . . . Now if a maiden comes out to draw water and I say to her Please let me drink a little water from your jar
verses.literalPt: Eis que estou junto à fonte de água; seja, pois, que a donzela que sair para tirar água e à qual eu disser: Peço-te, dá-me um pouco de água do teu cântaro;

verses.original: וְאָמְרָ֤ה אֵלַי֙ גַּם־ אַתָּ֣ה שְׁתֵ֔ה וְגַ֥ם לִגְמַלֶּ֖יךָ אֶשְׁאָ֑ב הִ֣וא הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ הֹכִ֥יחַ יְהוָ֖ה לְבֶן־ אֲדֹנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mə·rāh ’ê·lay gam- ’at·tāh šə·ṯêh wə·ḡam liḡ·mal·le·ḵā ’eš·’āḇ hî hā·’iš·šāh ’ă·šer- hō·ḵî·aḥ Yah·weh lə·ḇen- ’ă·ḏō·nî
verses.literal: and she replies . . . Drink . . . and I will draw water for your camels as well . . . may she be the woman the LORD has appointed for my master’s son
verses.literalPt: E ela me disser: Bebe tu e também tirarei água para os teus camelos; esta seja a mulher que o SENHOR designou ao filho de meu senhor.

verses.original: אֲנִי֩ טֶ֨רֶם אֲכַלֶּ֜ה לְדַבֵּ֣ר אֶל־ לִבִּ֗י וְהִנֵּ֨ה רִבְקָ֤ה יֹצֵאת֙ וְכַדָּ֣הּ עַל־ שִׁכְמָ֔הּ וַתֵּ֥רֶד הָעַ֖יְנָה וַתִּשְׁאָ֑ב וָאֹמַ֥ר אֵלֶ֖יהָ הַשְׁקִ֥ינִי נָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî ṭe·rem ’ă·ḵal·leh lə·ḏab·bêr ’el- lib·bî wə·hin·nêh riḇ·qāh yō·ṣêṯ wə·ḵad·dāh ‘al- šiḵ·māh wat·tê·reḏ hā·‘ay·nāh wat·tiš·’āḇ wā·’ō·mar ’ê·le·hā haš·qî·nî nā
verses.literal: And before I had finished praying in my heart there was Rebekah coming out with her jar on her shoulder and she went down to the spring and drew water So I said to her Please give me a drink
verses.literalPt: E antes que eu acabasse de falar no meu coração, eis que Rebeca saía com o seu cântaro sobre o seu ombro, desceu à fonte e tirou água; e eu lhe disse: Peço-te, dá-me de beber.

verses.original: וַתְּמַהֵ֗ר וַתּ֤וֹרֶד כַּדָּהּ֙ מֵֽעָלֶ֔יהָ וַתֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁתֵ֔ה וְגַם־ גְּמַלֶּ֖יךָ אַשְׁקֶ֑ה וָאֵ֕שְׁתְּ וְגַ֥ם הַגְּמַלִּ֖ים הִשְׁקָֽתָה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·ma·hêr wat·tō·w·reḏ kad·dāh mê·‘ā·le·hā wat·tō·mer šə·ṯêh wə·ḡam- gə·mal·le·ḵā ’aš·qeh wā·’ê·šət wə·ḡam hag·gə·mal·lîm hiš·qā·ṯāh
verses.literal: She quickly lowered her jar from her shoulder and said Drink and I will water your camels as well So I drank and she also watered the camels
verses.literalPt: E ela se apressou, e abaixou o seu cântaro de sobre si, e disse: Bebe, e também darei de beber aos teus camelos; e bebi, e ela deu também de beber aos camelos.

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁאַ֣ל אֹתָ֗הּ וָאֹמַר֮ בַּת־ מִ֣י אַתְּ֒ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר בַּת־ בְּתוּאֵל֙ בֶּן־ נָח֔וֹר אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָֽלְדָה־ לּ֖וֹ מִלְכָּ֑ה וָאָשִׂ֤ם הַנֶּ֙זֶם֙ עַל־ אַפָּ֔הּ וְהַצְּמִידִ֖ים עַל־ יָדֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eš·’al ’ō·ṯāh wā·’ō·mar baṯ- mî ’at wat·tō·mer baṯ- bə·ṯū·’êl ben- nā·ḥō·wr ’ă·šer yā·lə·ḏāh- lōw mil·kāh wā·’ā·śim han·ne·zem ‘al- ’ap·pāh wə·haṣ·ṣə·mî·ḏîm ‘al- yā·ḏe·hā
verses.literal: Then I asked her Whose daughter are you . . . She replied The daughter of Bethuel son of Nahor whom Milcah bore to him So I put the ring on her nose and the bracelets on her wrists
verses.literalPt: Então lhe perguntei, e disse: De quem és filha? E ela disse: Filha de Betuel, filho de Naor, que lhe deu Milca. Então eu pus o pendente no seu rosto, e as pulseiras sobre as suas mãos;

verses.original: וָאֶקֹּ֥ד וָֽאֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֖ה לַיהוָ֑ה וָאֲבָרֵ֗ךְ אֶת־ יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵי֙ אֲדֹנִ֣י אַבְרָהָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִנְחַ֙נִי֙ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ אֱמֶ֔ת לָקַ֛חַת אֶת־ בַּת־ אֲחִ֥י אֲדֹנִ֖י לִבְנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eq·qōḏ wā·’eš·ta·ḥă·weh Yah·weh wā·’ă·ḇā·rêḵ ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḏō·nî ’aḇ·rā·hām ’ă·šer hin·ḥa·nî bə·ḏe·reḵ ’ĕ·meṯ lā·qa·ḥaṯ ’eṯ- baṯ- ’ă·ḥî ’ă·ḏō·nî liḇ·nōw
verses.literal: Then I bowed down and worshiped the LORD and I blessed the LORD the God of my master Abraham who led me on the right road to take the granddaughter of my master’s brother for his son
verses.literalPt: E inclinando-me adorei ao SENHOR, e bendisse ao SENHOR, Deus do meu senhor Abraão, que me havia encaminhado pelo caminho da verdade, para tomar a filha do irmão de meu senhor para seu filho.

verses.original: וְ֠עַתָּה אִם־ יֶשְׁכֶ֨ם עֹשִׂ֜ים חֶ֧סֶד וֶֽאֱמֶ֛ת אֶת־ אֲדֹנִ֖י הַגִּ֣ידוּ לִ֑י וְאִם־ לֹ֕א הַגִּ֣ידוּ לִ֔י וְאֶפְנֶ֥ה עַל־ יָמִ֖ין א֥וֹ עַל־ שְׂמֹֽאל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ’im- yeš·ḵem ‘ō·śîm ḥe·seḏ we·’ĕ·meṯ ’eṯ- ’ă·ḏō·nî hag·gî·ḏū lî wə·’im- lō hag·gî·ḏū lî wə·’ep̄·neh ‘al- yā·mîn ’ōw ‘al- śə·mōl
verses.literal: Now if you will show kindness and faithfulness to my master tell me but if not let me know so that I may go elsewhere . . . . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, se vós haveis de fazer benevolência e verdade a meu senhor, fazei-mo saber; e se não, também mo fazei saber, para que eu vá à direita, ou à esquerda.

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַן לָבָ֤ן וּבְתוּאֵל֙ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ מֵיְהוָ֖ה יָצָ֣א הַדָּבָ֑ר לֹ֥א נוּכַ֛ל דַּבֵּ֥ר אֵלֶ֖יךָ רַ֥ע אוֹ־ טֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an lā·ḇān ū·ḇə·ṯū·’êl way·yō·mə·rū Yah·weh yā·ṣā had·dā·ḇār lō nū·ḵal dab·bêr ’ê·le·ḵā ra‘ ’ōw- ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: Laban and Bethuel . . . answered This is from the LORD we have no choice . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . in the matter
verses.literalPt: Então responderam Labão e Betuel, e disseram: Do SENHOR procedeu este negócio; não podemos falar-te mal ou bem.

verses.original: הִנֵּֽה־ רִבְקָ֥ה לְפָנֶ֖יךָ קַ֣ח וָלֵ֑ךְ וּתְהִ֤י אִשָּׁה֙ לְבֶן־ אֲדֹנֶ֔יךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh- riḇ·qāh lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā qaḥ wā·lêḵ ū·ṯə·hî ’iš·šāh lə·ḇen- ’ă·ḏō·ne·ḵā ka·’ă·šer dib·ber Yah·weh
verses.literal: Rebekah is here before you Take her and go and let her become the wife of your master’s son just as the LORD has decreed
verses.literalPt: Eis que Rebeca está diante da tua face; toma-a, e vai-te; seja a mulher do filho de teu senhor, como tem dito o SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁמַ֛ע עֶ֥בֶד אַבְרָהָ֖ם אֶת־ דִּבְרֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּשְׁתַּ֥חוּ אַ֖רְצָה לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ka·’ă·šer šā·ma‘ ‘e·ḇeḏ ’aḇ·rā·hām ’eṯ- diḇ·rê·hem way·yiš·ta·ḥū ’ar·ṣāh Yah·weh
verses.literal: When Abraham’s servant heard their words he bowed down to the ground before the LORD
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que, o servo de Abraão, ouvindo as suas palavras, inclinou-se à terra diante do SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיּוֹצֵ֨א הָעֶ֜בֶד כְּלֵי־ כֶ֨סֶף וּכְלֵ֤י זָהָב֙ וּבְגָדִ֔ים וַיִּתֵּ֖ן לְרִבְקָ֑ה וּמִ֨גְדָּנֹ֔ת נָתַ֥ן לְאָחִ֖יהָ וּלְאִמָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·w·ṣê hā·‘e·ḇeḏ kə·lê- ḵe·sep̄ ū·ḵə·lê zā·hāḇ ū·ḇə·ḡā·ḏîm way·yit·tên lə·riḇ·qāh ū·miḡ·dā·nōṯ nā·ṯan lə·’ā·ḥî·hā ū·lə·’im·māh
verses.literal: Then he brought out jewels of silver . . . and gold and articles of clothing and he gave them to Rebekah He also gave precious gifts to her brother and her mother
verses.literalPt: E tirou o servo jóias de prata e jóias de ouro, e vestidos, e deu-os a Rebeca; também deu coisas preciosas a seu irmão e à sua mãe.

verses.original: וַיֹּאכְל֣וּ וַיִּשְׁתּ֗וּ ה֛וּא וְהָאֲנָשִׁ֥ים אֲשֶׁר־ עִמּ֖וֹ וַיָּלִ֑ינוּ וַיָּק֣וּמוּ בַבֹּ֔קֶר וַיֹּ֖אמֶר שַׁלְּחֻ֥נִי לַֽאדֹנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·ḵə·lū way·yiš·tū hū wə·hā·’ă·nā·šîm ’ă·šer- ‘im·mōw way·yā·lî·nū way·yā·qū·mū ḇab·bō·qer way·yō·mer šal·lə·ḥu·nî la·ḏō·nî
verses.literal: Then he and the men with him ate and drank and spent the night there When they got up the next morning he said Send me on my way to my master
verses.literalPt: Então comeram e beberam, ele e os homens que com ele estavam, e passaram a noite. E levantaram-se pela manhã, e disse: Deixai-me ir a meu senhor.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אָחִ֙יהָ֙ וְאִמָּ֔הּ תֵּשֵׁ֨ב הַנַּעֲרָ֥ אִתָּ֛נוּ יָמִ֖ים א֣וֹ עָשׂ֑וֹר אַחַ֖ר תֵּלֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ā·ḥî·hā wə·’im·māh tê·šêḇ han·na·‘ă·rā ’it·tā·nū yā·mîm ’ōw ‘ā·śō·wr ’a·ḥar tê·lêḵ
verses.literal: But her brother and mother said Let the girl remain with us ten days or so After that she may go
verses.literalPt: Então disseram seu irmão e sua mãe: Fique a donzela conosco alguns dias, ou pelo menos dez dias, depois irá.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵהֶם֙ אַל־ תְּאַחֲר֣וּ אֹתִ֔י וַֽיהוָ֖ה הִצְלִ֣יחַ דַּרְכִּ֑י שַׁלְּח֕וּנִי וְאֵלְכָ֖ה לַֽאדֹנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem ’al- tə·’a·ḥă·rū ’ō·ṯî Yah·weh hiṣ·lî·aḥ dar·kî šal·lə·ḥū·nî wə·’ê·lə·ḵāh la·ḏō·nî
verses.literal: But he replied . . . Do not delay me since the LORD has made my journey a success Send me on my way so that I may go to my master
verses.literalPt: Ele, porém, lhes disse: Não me detenhais, pois o SENHOR tem prosperado o meu caminho; deixai-me partir, para que eu volte a meu SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ נִקְרָ֣א לַֽנַּעֲרָ֑ וְנִשְׁאֲלָ֖ה אֶת־ פִּֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū niq·rā lan·na·‘ă·rā wə·niš·’ă·lāh ’eṯ- pî·hā
verses.literal: So they said We will call the girl and ask her opinion
verses.literalPt: E disseram: Chamemos a donzela, e perguntemos-lho.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרְא֤וּ לְרִבְקָה֙ וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלֶ֔יהָ הֲתֵלְכִ֖י עִם־ הָאִ֣ישׁ הַזֶּ֑ה וַתֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rə·’ū lə·riḇ·qāh way·yō·mə·rū ’ê·le·hā hă·ṯê·lə·ḵî ‘im- hā·’îš haz·zeh wat·tō·mer ’ê·lêḵ
verses.literal: They called Rebekah and asked her Will you go with this man I will go she replied
verses.literalPt: E chamaram a Rebeca, e disseram-lhe: Irás tu com este homem? Ela respondeu: Irei.

verses.original: וַֽיְשַׁלְּח֛וּ אֶת־ רִבְקָ֥ה אֲחֹתָ֖ם וְאֶת־ מֵנִקְתָּ֑הּ וְאֶת־ עֶ֥בֶד אַבְרָהָ֖ם וְאֶת־ אֲנָשָֽׁיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·šal·lə·ḥū ’eṯ- riḇ·qāh ’ă·ḥō·ṯām wə·’eṯ- mê·niq·tāh wə·’eṯ- ‘e·ḇeḏ ’aḇ·rā·hām wə·’eṯ- ’ă·nā·šāw
verses.literal: So they sent their sister Rebekah on her way along with her nurse and Abraham’s servant and his men
verses.literalPt: Então despediram a Rebeca, sua irmã, e sua ama, e o servo de Abraão, e seus homens.

verses.original: וַיְבָרֲכ֤וּ אֶת־ רִבְקָה֙ וַיֹּ֣אמְרוּ לָ֔הּ אֲחֹתֵ֕נוּ אַ֥תְּ הֲיִ֖י לְאַלְפֵ֣י רְבָבָ֑ה וְיִירַ֣שׁ זַרְעֵ֔ךְ אֵ֖ת שַׁ֥עַר שֹׂנְאָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḇā·ră·ḵū ’eṯ- riḇ·qāh way·yō·mə·rū lāh ’ă·ḥō·ṯê·nū ’at hă·yî lə·’al·p̄ê rə·ḇā·ḇāh wə·yî·raš zar·‘êḵ ’êṯ ša·‘ar śō·nə·’āw
verses.literal: And they blessed Rebekah and said to her Our sister may you become the mother of thousands upon thousands May your offspring possess the gates of their enemies
verses.literalPt: E abençoaram a Rebeca, e disseram-lhe: Ó nossa irmã, sê tu a mãe de milhares de milhares, e que a tua descendência possua a porta de seus aborrecedores!

verses.original: וַתָּ֨קָם רִבְקָ֜ה וְנַעֲרֹתֶ֗יהָ וַתִּרְכַּ֙בְנָה֙ עַל־ הַגְּמַלִּ֔ים וַתֵּלַ֖כְנָה אַחֲרֵ֣י הָאִ֑ישׁ וַיִּקַּ֥ח הָעֶ֛בֶד אֶת־ רִבְקָ֖ה וַיֵּלַֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·qām riḇ·qāh wə·na·‘ă·rō·ṯe·hā wat·tir·kaḇ·nāh ‘al- hag·gə·mal·lîm wat·tê·laḵ·nāh ’a·ḥă·rê hā·’îš way·yiq·qaḥ hā·‘e·ḇeḏ ’eṯ- riḇ·qāh way·yê·laḵ
verses.literal: Then Rebekah and her servant girls got ready mounted . . . the camels and followed . . . the man So the servant took Rebekah and left
verses.literalPt: E Rebeca se levantou com as suas moças, e subiram sobre os camelos, e seguiram o homem; e tomou aquele servo a Rebeca, e partiu.

verses.original: וְיִצְחָק֙ בָּ֣א מִבּ֔וֹא בְּאֵ֥ר לַחַ֖י רֹאִ֑י וְה֥וּא יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּאֶ֥רֶץ הַנֶּֽגֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yiṣ·ḥāq bā mib·bō·w bə·’êr la·ḥay rō·’î wə·hū yō·wō·šêḇ bə·’e·reṣ han·ne·ḡeḇ
verses.literal: Now Isaac had just returned from Beer-lahai-roi for he was living in the Negev . . .
verses.literalPt: Ora, Isaque vinha de onde se vem do poço de Beer-Laai-Rói; porque habitava na terra do sul.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֥א יִצְחָ֛ק לָשׂ֥וּחַ בַּשָּׂדֶ֖ה לִפְנ֣וֹת עָ֑רֶב וַיִּשָּׂ֤א עֵינָיו֙ וַיַּ֔רְא וְהִנֵּ֥ה גְמַלִּ֖ים בָּאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê yiṣ·ḥāq lā·śū·aḥ baś·śā·ḏeh lip̄·nō·wṯ ‘ā·reḇ way·yiś·śā ‘ê·nāw way·yar wə·hin·nêh ḡə·mal·lîm bā·’îm
verses.literal: Early in the evening Isaac went out to the field to meditate . . . and looking up . . . he saw . . . the camels approaching
verses.literalPt: E Isaque saíra a orar no campo, à tarde; e levantou os seus olhos, e olhou, e eis que os camelos vinham.

verses.original: וַתִּשָּׂ֤א רִבְקָה֙ אֶת־ עֵינֶ֔יהָ וַתֵּ֖רֶא אֶת־ יִצְחָ֑ק וַתִּפֹּ֖ל מֵעַ֥ל הַגָּמָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiś·śā riḇ·qāh ’eṯ- ‘ê·ne·hā wat·tê·re ’eṯ- yiṣ·ḥāq wat·tip·pōl mê·‘al hag·gā·māl
verses.literal: And when Rebekah looked up - and saw Isaac she got down from her camel
verses.literalPt: Rebeca também levantou seus olhos, e viu a Isaque, e desceu do camelo.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל־ הָעֶ֗בֶד מִֽי־ הָאִ֤ישׁ הַלָּזֶה֙ הַהֹלֵ֤ךְ בַּשָּׂדֶה֙ לִקְרָאתֵ֔נוּ וַיֹּ֥אמֶר הָעֶ֖בֶד ה֣וּא אֲדֹנִ֑י וַתִּקַּ֥ח הַצָּעִ֖יף וַתִּתְכָּֽס׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer ’el- hā·‘e·ḇeḏ mî- hā·’îš hal·lā·zeh ha·hō·lêḵ baś·śā·ḏeh liq·rā·ṯê·nū way·yō·mer hā·‘e·ḇeḏ hū ’ă·ḏō·nî wat·tiq·qaḥ haṣ·ṣā·‘îp̄ wat·tiṯ·kās
verses.literal: and asked . . . the servant Who is that man in the field coming to meet us It is my master the servant answered So she took her veil and covered herself
verses.literalPt: E disse ao servo: Quem é aquele homem que vem pelo campo ao nosso encontro? E o servo disse: Este é meu SENHOR. Então tomou ela o véu e cobriu-se.

verses.original: וַיְסַפֵּ֥ר הָעֶ֖בֶד לְיִצְחָ֑ק אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: way·sap·pêr hā·‘e·ḇeḏ lə·yiṣ·ḥāq ’êṯ kāl- had·də·ḇā·rîm ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh
verses.literal: Then the servant told Isaac all . . . that he had done
verses.literalPt: E o servo contou a Isaque todas as coisas que fizera.

verses.original: וַיְבִאֶ֣הָ יִצְחָ֗ק הָאֹ֙הֱלָה֙ שָׂרָ֣ה אִמּ֔וֹ וַיִּקַּ֧ח אֶת־ רִבְקָ֛ה וַתְּהִי־ ל֥וֹ לְאִשָּׁ֖ה וַיֶּאֱהָבֶ֑הָ וַיִּנָּחֵ֥ם יִצְחָ֖ק אַחֲרֵ֥י אִמּֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·ḇi·’e·hā yiṣ·ḥāq hā·’ō·hĕ·lāh śā·rāh ’im·mōw way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- riḇ·qāh wat·tə·hî- lōw lə·’iš·šāh way·ye·’ĕ·hā·ḇe·hā way·yin·nā·ḥêm yiṣ·ḥāq ’a·ḥă·rê ’im·mōw
verses.literal: And Isaac brought her into the tent of his mother Sarah and took Rebekah as his wife And Isaac loved her and was comforted after his mother’s death
verses.literalPt: E Isaque trouxe-a para a tenda de sua mãe Sara, e tomou a Rebeca, e foi-lhe por mulher, e amou-a. Assim Isaque foi consolado depois da morte de sua mãe.
